subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: Where a harness able to drive the feature's primary external interface already exists in the repo, the harness section shall cite that harness and specify only this feature's additions to it — the fixtures, fakes, and helpers this feature needs — rather than restating or re-deciding its mechanics.
rationale: the mechanical design is paid once per app shape and reused thereafter; a citation plus a delta keeps sibling features on one harness instead of forking it
fit_criterion: on a fixture whose harness already exists, the harness section cites it and lists only additions, with no element of FR-19 re-decided; on a fixture with no existing harness, the section carries the full FR-19 design; a section that restates a cited harness's mechanics differently is a review finding
